svg.title: Cumulative federal cannabis tax burden since 2018
svg.desc: Cumulative $27B in federal cannabis tax since 2018; $15B is the 280E excess that cannabis operators cannot deduct. 2025 alone added $2.24B in excess 280E. The IRS Statistics of Income division does not publish a 280E-specific line; Whitney is the de facto citation standard.

rect.title: Baseline federal tax (would have applied absent 280E): $12B
